users.title: Users and roles
users.subtitle: Assign roles from the fixed list. Roles can't be created, renamed or deleted.
users.name: Name
users.assignHint: The person is told at once and their menu updates.
users.endDateHelp: Leave empty for no end date. Useful for a judge on one challenge.
users.removeBody: {{name}} will lose the {{role}} role and its access at once.
users.emptyHint: Try a different name or clear the role filter.
users.rolesPanelHint: Read only. Team leader and team member are not roles; they come from creating or joining a team.

org.title: Organization
org.subtitle: The group and its companies are the SBUs; the units under them are their departments. Add or edit one here and it shows at sign-up, in ideas and in challenges straight away.
org.deleteBody: This can't be undone. A unit that still has people, units under it or records can't be deleted; switch it to inactive instead.
org.head: Head: {{name}}
org.codeHelp: Short and unique, for example AES_QA.
org.codeLocked: The code can't be changed after the unit is created.
org.activeHelp: Inactive units stay on old records but can't be chosen for new ones.

master.title: Lists & categories
master.subtitle: The lists people choose from. Changes apply at once, with no code release.

hint.domains: Any business area a challenge can belong to, not only technology.
hint.categories: Innovation categories for ideas and challenges.
hint.skills: Skills people add to their profile.
hint.lookups: Deactivated values stay on old records but can't be chosen again.

master.activeHelp: Only active items can be chosen in forms.

forms.title: Form builder
forms.subtitle: Change the questions people answer in methodology, prototype and final submissions.
forms.liveNote: Changes apply at once to every challenge that uses this form. Answers already submitted are kept.
forms.noFields: This section has no fields yet.
forms.removeBody: "{{label}}" will no longer be asked. Answers already given stay on old submissions.
forms.previewHint: This is what participants see. Typing here saves nothing.
forms.label: Question
forms.labelHelp: Write it as a short, plain question.
forms.helpHelp: Shown under the field. A good example helps most.
forms.requiredHelp: The form can't be submitted without an answer.

scorecards.title: Scoring sheets
scorecards.subtitle: Set the criteria judges score and how much each one counts.
scorecards.liveNote: Changes apply to reviews scored from now on and are recorded in the audit log. Confirmed shortlists keep their frozen scores.
scorecards.minRatingHelp: An entry fails the stage if its average is below this.
scorecards.guidanceHelp: Shown next to the rating buttons.
scorecards.tieBreakerHelp: Used first when two entries have the same score. Only one criterion can be the tie-breaker.
scorecards.needWeights: Give every criterion a weight above 0.
scorecards.noChanges: There are no changes to save.
scorecards.scaleHint: What each number means. Judges see this on screen.

workflows.title: Process steps
workflows.subtitle: The stages a record moves through and who may move it.
workflows.diagramHint: States are grouped from left to right. Arrows show where each state can go next.
workflows.statesHint: You can change the name people see and the time limit.
workflows.stateNameHelp: Shown on status badges and in emails.
workflows.slaHelp: Leave empty for no limit. Reminders and escalations use this.
workflows.transitionsHint: Each row is one button. Rules are checked on the server.
workflows.noTransitions: No transitions are stored for this workflow.
workflows.noTransitionsHint: Its status follows challenge phases and review results.

guard.requires_kpi_baseline: Primary KPI with baseline and target

notify.title: Notifications
notify.subtitle: Email templates, who receives what, and the delivery log.
notify.templatesHint: Emails carry a short summary and a secure link. Confidential details are never put in the email.
notify.subject: Subject
notify.bodyHelp: Plain text. Use the variables below.
notify.variablesHint: Select one to add it to the end of the body.
notify.templateActiveHelp: When off, a plain default email is sent instead.
notify.previewHint: Sample values are used here. Real emails use the real record.
notify.rulesHint: Extra recipients for an event, on top of the people involved.
notify.rulesNote: New ideas go to the designated reviewer mailbox through the rule for "Initiative needs review". Change the mailbox in Settings, or point the rule at another address here.
notify.eventHelp: The rule runs each time this happens.
notify.emailInvalid: Enter a full email address, like name@company.com.
notify.noDeliveries: No emails have been sent yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: System settings, feature switches and system health.
settings.generalHint: Every change is recorded in the audit log.
settings.numberRequired: Enter a number of 0 or more.
settings.flagsHint: Turn features on or off for everyone.
settings.privacyNote: Privacy: this shows finalists' public summaries to other employees. Keep it off unless the program owner has agreed.

key.triage_sla_days: First response to a new idea (working days)
key.team_submit_leader_only: Only the team leader can submit

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what and when. Records can't be edited or deleted.
audit.empty: No audit records match these filters.
audit.noChanges: No field values were recorded for this action.
